stem.text: Hydrated aluminium ions undergo the following reaction.
Which statement about this reaction is correct?

A.text: $\text{H}_2\text{O(l)}$ and $[\text{Al(H}_2\text{O)}_5\text{OH}]^{2+}\text{(aq)}$ are a conjugate acid-base pair.

B.text: $\text{H}_2\text{O(l)}$ is acting as an acid as it is donating $\text{H}^{+}$ ions.

C.text: If $\text{OH}^{-}\text{(aq)}$ is added, the equilibrium will move to the right.

D.text: $K_\text{c}$ varies as the pH is varied.
